regressions.source: SPBEAM.set: abi.decode of the rate getter's return (uint256)
regressions.issue: The return-data size check after the join now carries the free pointer's full value on both sides, negative term first; it means return_data.size >= 32.
regressions.rule: Keep the free-pointer read in a temporary at a join (p = mem[64]) and cancel equal terms across the difference; order sums positive-first.

improvements: The rate getter calls are decoded (unknown538af037(ext_call.return_data[0]) x3, unknown30cffa04(...) x2; P2 15 -> 0 by the header), the two 'SPBEAM/delta-above-step' reverts are decoded, and the Cfg fields are read as uint16(stor2[id].field_0/16/32) instead of slices of their memory copy (valid: only static calls lie between the load and the uses).
notes: Diff 224 lines, all in set(): read in full with a control-statement diff. The single source loop is unchanged.
summary: One low regression (a longer, negative-first return-size check); calls, reverts and struct fields are now readable.
